patch_description:
Add a second, low-temperature basin-hopping polishing phase after the broad multi-start search. The existing annealing stage is effective at locating a near-optimal packing, but its relatively high-temperature trajectory can stop slightly away from the nonsmooth optimum determined by a small active set of shortest and diameter pairs.

The added phase perturbs the best incumbent by a small reproducible amount and re-optimizes it with a much sharper soft-min/soft-max approximation. This specifically searches nearby contact-graph variants while retaining the incumbent unless a strictly improved true squared ratio is found. Diameter normalization is retained after every move, so the new search remains in the same translation/scale quotient space and always returns exactly fourteen finite 3D points.
